name: Qualtrics
description: Qualtrics is a survey research and experience-management platform for designing complex studies, collecting feedback, analyzing response data, and building research dashboards.
best_for: Research teams and organizations that need complex survey logic, advanced statistical analysis, dashboards, and enterprise-grade experience research.
features: Survey Flow with branch, display, and skip logic
Embedded data, randomization, authentication, and quotas
Email, SMS, and anonymous-link survey distribution
Data cleaning, filtering, exports, and response management

tiers.name: Qualtrics Surveys Free
tiers.notes: Free single-user account with 3 active surveys, 30 questions per survey, 500 total responses, 50+ templates, 8 question types, and basic survey logic according to Qualtrics' current buy-online page.

tiers.name: Strategic Research
tiers.notes: Special online pricing shown as $420/month, billed $5,040 annually for 1,000 responses shared across users. Includes unlimited users, surveys, and questions plus advanced analysis capabilities.

pros: Free account provides a real entry point for limited survey projects
Advanced survey flow supports branching, embedded data, randomization, authentication, and other complex research paths
Data and Analysis tooling includes filtering, cleaning, crosstabs, weighting, statistics, text analysis, and reporting
cons: The public paid entry point is materially more expensive than self-service form and survey tools
The free account is limited to three active surveys, 30 questions per survey, and 500 total responses
Many advanced features vary by license and larger deployments require custom pricing

faq.question: Does Qualtrics have a free survey plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualtrics currently offers a free single-user survey account with three active surveys, up to 30 questions per survey, and 500 total responses.

faq.question: How much does Qualtrics Strategic Research cost?
faq.answer: Qualtrics currently shows special online pricing of $420 per month, billed as $5,040 annually, for its entry Strategic Research package with 1,000 responses shared across users.

faq.question: Does Qualtrics support advanced survey logic?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualtrics Survey Flow supports branching, embedded data, randomization, authentication, and other logic used to create personalized or controlled research paths.

alternatives.name: SurveyMonkey
alternatives.description: A survey and feedback platform with broad templates, AI-assisted survey creation and analysis, advanced logic, and a large integration ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a lower-friction survey platform with broad research and feedback use cases

alternatives.name: Typeform
alternatives.description: An interactive forms and surveys platform focused on conversational form experiences, logic, integrations, and branded data collection.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that prioritize respondent experience and polished interactive forms

alternatives.name: Jotform
alternatives.description: A no-code form builder with a large template library, payments, conditional logic, workflows, and broad form customization.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that need flexible operational forms and lower-cost data collection
